description_en: Obtains the OSS resource configuration information for qualification materials. This configuration information will be used for subsequent uploads of qualification files such as authorization letters and enterprise certificates
description_zh: 获取资质材料OSS资源配置信息，此配置信息将用于后续授权委托书、企业证件等资质文件的上传操作
name: GetQualificationOssInfo

parameters.help_en: The business type. When applying for a qualification or creating an authorization letter file, enter **dysms**
parameters.help_zh: 业务类型。申请资质或创建授权委托书文件时请填写**dysms**
parameters.name: biz_type
